about: Our own shot list for small product shops: what each photo is for, how to take it with a phone, and how to name the file. Platform photo counts and sizes change, so the list says to check the counter when you upload.

base.shot: Front view on a plain light background
base.why: Your first photo: it shows in search, collections and shares.
base.how: Window light from the side, white card on the other side to soften shadows, phone at the product's height.

base.why: Shows depth and shape the front view hides.
base.how: Same setup, turn the product 45 degrees.

base.shot: Close-up of texture, finish or stitching
base.why: Answers the quality question a shopper can't ask in person.
base.how: Move the phone closer instead of zooming; tap to focus on the detail.

base.shot: Next to a hand or a common object
base.why: Shows the real size, the most common reason for returns.
base.how: A hand, a mug or a phone beside it. Write the size in the description too.

base.shot: In use, in a real room or on a person
base.why: Helps a shopper picture it in their own life.
base.how: Natural light, a tidy real setting, one prop at most.

base.shot: What arrives: the packaging and anything inside
base.why: Shows it's ready to give as a gift.
base.how: Open box from above, everything laid out.

base.shot: Every color or size side by side
base.why: Lets shoppers compare in one look.
base.how: Same light and distance for each, in one row.

candles.label: Candles and home fragrance

extra.why: Shows the glow and the jar with light behind it.
extra.how: Turn off overhead lights, use a lamp off to the side, hold the phone steady on a surface.

candles.watch: Never leave a lit candle alone during the shoot.

jewelry.label: Jewelry

extra.why: Shows how it sits and its true size.
extra.how: Crop at the neck, ear or wrist; soft window light.

jewelry.watch: Wipe fingerprints before every shot; metal shows everything.

extra.why: Shoppers check measurements before size labels.
extra.how: Shoot straight down; lay a tape measure across the chest and length.

extra.why: Shoppers want to see the back before they buy.

ceramics.label: Ceramics and home goods

extra.why: Shows it's handmade and how it's finished.
extra.how: Turn it over on a soft cloth.

ceramics.watch: Show any glaze variation honestly; handmade pieces differ.

food.label: Food and drink

extra.how: Straight on, no glare: tilt the jar slightly away from the window.

food.watch: Show the real product, not a styled look-alike.

bath.label: Soap, skincare and bath

extra.why: Shoppers check ingredients before they buy.

bath.watch: No before-and-after photos of skin, and no health claims in captions.

art.label: Art and prints

extra.shot: On a wall, with furniture for scale
extra.why: Shows the size in a room.
extra.how: Shoot straight on at the print's center height.

art.watch: Color check: compare the photo on your phone with the real print before you upload.

other.label: Something else
other.watch: Shoot every product the same way so your shop looks like one shop.

setup: A window with daylight, no direct sun. Turn off the room lights so colors stay true.
A sheet of white poster board bent into a curve for the background.
A second white card on the side away from the window to fill shadows.
Clean the phone lens. Lock focus and exposure by holding your finger on the product.
Shoot at the same time of day for every product, so the whole shop matches.
sizes: Upload large, square or 4:3 photos with the product filling most of the frame. Shopify and Etsy each show their current photo count and size advice when you upload: check the counter there.
